content.text:
`saveAll` now waits for every write before it resolves.

**The bug:** `store.js` used `items.forEach(async ...)`. `forEach` ignores the promises its callback returns, so the function reached `return items.length` while the `db.put` calls were still pending.

**The fix** (`store.js`):

```js
async function saveAll(items, db) {
  await Promise.all(items.map((item) => db.put(item.id, item)));
  return items.length;
}
```

`Promise.all` waits for all writes, and it rejects if any one of them fails, which matches the existing comment.

**Tests:** The existing test passed even with the bug, because its fake `put` stores the item synchronously. I added two tests to `test/store.test.js`:
- **resolves only after every write has finished:** uses a `put` with a 10ms delay. It failed before the fix (`0 !== 2`) and passes now.
- **rejects if a write fails:** checks that a failing write makes `saveAll` reject. It failed before the fix, and the unhandled `boom` rejection surfaced as an error. It passes now.
